## Public release

The complete saRNA Database v1.0.0 package is preserved and distributed through Zenodo. The archive contains the authoritative Excel workbook, CSV tables, documentation, changelog, and license.

::: {.sarna-archive-callout}
**Open the permanent archive**

<a href="https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21871232" data-umami-event="archive-open">saRNA Database v1.0.0 on Zenodo</a>

Version DOI: `10.5281/zenodo.21871232`
:::

This website provides a searchable presentation of the released data but does not provide separate file-download buttons. Please use Zenodo when obtaining or citing the complete package.
